title: Paperless Addition to Restored Dual-Fuel Credits (Residential Electricity Supply)
content:
Promotions rule, Residential Electricity Supply. A restored dual-fuel credit carries a paperless addition reflecting how the customer deals with Beacon Ridge electronically.

**Rule.** When the agreement was enrolled through the web and at least one notice on the agreement was delivered by email, the full paperless addition of 0.50 USD is added; when exactly one of those two holds, the partial paperless addition of 0.25 USD is added; when neither holds, nothing is added.

**Records read.** The enrollment channel recorded on the agreement, and the delivery channel of the notices recorded on the agreement (renewal, final options, rate change and pass-through notices alike).

| Enrolled through the web | At least one notice delivered by email | Paperless addition |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | 0.50 USD |
| yes | no | 0.25 USD |
| no | yes | 0.25 USD |
| no | no | nothing |

**Example (hypothetical).** An agreement enrolled by phone whose renewal notices went by mail adds nothing; the same agreement with one notice delivered by email adds 0.25 USD.
